choices: Select Wolf, Rat, Riding Horse or Spider at level 2, plus Black Bear or Giant Badger at 4. Keep HP and mental scores, use physical scores, movement, armor, size and attack data of the chosen form.

Choose drop or merge for carried weapons, shields and body armor. A second menu distinguishes borrowed armor. Arena ruling: all six animals lack hands and do not fit armor tailored to the humanoid Dwarves. Dropped gear stays on the board; merged gear is inactive until reversion.

cost: Voluntary Bonus Action; also ends at incapacitation or defeat
choices: Spells already cast can persist, but new casts are unavailable. Going Prone alone does not end a form. Gain temporary HP equal to Druid level and keep own Hit Points.

trigger: Wolf uses Bite or has an ally by its target
choices: Medium-or-smaller creatures hit by Bite go Prone. The Wolf has Pack Tactics when an active ally is within 5 feet of the target.

trigger: Rat bites or leaves hostile reach
choices: Tiny body, natural climb speed and Agile movement without provoking an opportunity attack. Bite has fixed damage even on a critical hit.

cost: Bonus Action to transform; movement thereafter
choices: Choose a fitting 2×2 footprint that retains the original cell or squeeze; Hooves deal bludgeoning damage. The 60-foot speed is measured on the grid.
Tiny Spider can climb the ceiling. Its Bite deals a fixed 1 Piercing and separately rolled 1d4 Poison so poison resistance applies only to that component.
Attack once, or use the separate two-Rend Multiattack, choosing each target independently and optionally moving in between. The additional Rend cannot be replaced by a generic grapple or shove.

trigger: Giant Badger picks its attack and takes Poison damage
choices: Medium body, AC 13, 30-foot speed, Bite with 2d4 + 1 Piercing and resistance to Poison. Burrow speed works in burrowable material; the arena has solid stone walls and floor.

trigger: A form swims in water or contacts a web
choices: The four stone arena maps have no water or webs and no prepared spell or listed creature action creates either. Hair, cloth and vegetation of Entangle do not count as a web.
